annotator: Five crowd annotators of the HLGD authors; the label is their aggregate group (global_group) in hlgd_original_annotations.json.
boundaryRule: Two headlines of one timeline are one event when the annotators put them in one group. The set is the headlines of the HLGD test pairs.

source.name: Headline Grouping dataset (HLGD), release 0.1, test split
source.licence: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE; Hugging Face card philippelaban/hlgd). The headlines belong to their publishers; the authors distribute them as fair use (LEGAL.md). This repository holds only annotation indexes, dates, publishers and the group labels.
source.attribution: Philippe Laban, Lucas Bandarkar and Marti A. Hearst. 2021. News Headline Grouping as a Challenging NLU Task. In Proceedings of NAACL 2021.

weaknesses: Headlines only. The detector never joins a headline-only report (ADR 0003), so this set measures the cost of that rule, not the grouping.
